description: Get a link a workspace owner or admin opens to connect an Amazon seller account (platform "amazon", optional region na/eu/fe) or a Shopify shop (platform "shopify", shop "your-store.myshopify.com"). Optionally appId ties the store to one product. The owner approves at Amazon or Shopify; nothing is connected until they do, and no credential passes through this tool. Nooticr only asks for access to listing copy and prices. Each call mints a fresh link. No cost to call. Use when the user wants to connect their Amazon or Shopify store.

appId.description: Product id to tie the store to.

name: connect_store

connectUrl.description: Open this in a browser to approve the connection.
